purpose: Predeclared evidence obligations; no checker implementation or app acceptance supplied.

decision_rules.pass: All required observations for the row exist on the latest registered observation of the frozen attempt and match current source/deployment/org/user identities. Missing actual observations cannot pass.
decision_rules.fail: A bound actual observation demonstrates a stated falsifier; retain raw evidence and attribution.
decision_rules.unknown: Required evidence unavailable, incomplete, ambiguous or outside the frozen observation deadline. Queue delay alone is UNKNOWN, not product failure.
decision_rules.overall: All rows required. Native mocks cannot replace live org, real-provider, browser or independent review evidence. Apparatus qualification and workflow judgment remain separate from app acceptance.
decision_rules.supersession: Register each observation before fallible work; latest unique registered observation supersedes earlier credit even if incomplete. Preserve earlier receipts; never backfill a newer failure from older success.
decision_rules.calibration: Qualify evaluators with controlled positive and falsifier fixtures independently. Application-authored logs and declarative independent flags alone do not establish independence.
decision_rules.intake_boundary: INTAKE rows are outer evaluator/operator controls, not deployed Apex behavior or per-chat questions. This declared create needs no mode-choice question. Future unspecified mode requires clean-create versus feature/additive choice before destructive reset; feature preserves its verified predecessor.
decision_rules.setup_boundary: Before builder launch require canonical target/user and deployment/setup authority, verified startup reset, exact job/deployment containment, operator credential-reference/setup route and grants as appropriate, and actual observation capability/contract. Do not require a nonexistent new app. Post-build SETUP-01 supplies real app Save, independent persisted config readback and app-initiated actual connection before dependent UI/provider acceptance; blocked provider outcomes remain UNKNOWN. No live deployment without authority, reset or containment.

rows.outcome: Declared run_kind=create gates every independent full-case builder attempt, including the first, on completed startup reset and verification.
rows.independent_evidence: Canonical org/case/run ownership inventory covering prior declared TEST-OWNED resources and all inventory-linked prefixes; exact job/deployment accounting, stop/invalidate/quiesce/teardown receipts and independent covered absence/restoration before builder start. Known empty target has observed empty-inventory/no-op reset receipt.
rows.falsifier: Builder starts with old owned app/job leftovers despite a new prefix, folder or browser; failed/unknown cleanup is accepted; first attempt skips reset; an existence check alone or assumed empty target passes; unrelated apps/data/User accounts, other work, owner keys or evidence are deleted.
rows.unknown_condition: Unknown ownership, conflicting active work/jobs, in-flight or late deployment risk, missing inventory, no-op receipt or incomplete/failed independent cleanup blocks launch/reuse.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Calibration fixtures do not establish actual live reset; live launch requires independently observed target receipts.

rows.outcome: Outer intake asks clean-create versus feature/additive for future unspecified scenarios before destructive reset; feature preserves its explicitly verified predecessor. This declared create does not ask again.
rows.independent_evidence: Independently calibrated intake controls for declared create, unspecified mode, existing app with no declared mode, and feature with verified predecessor/declared synthetic fixture reset.
rows.falsifier: Unknown mode silently resets or infers feature from app presence; feature reset deletes predecessor app/evidence; mode choice is exposed in finished bot or each chat; declared create asks redundantly.
rows.unknown_condition: Unresolved future mode or unverified feature predecessor blocks dependent reset/launch.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Calibration fixtures do not establish actual live reset; live launch requires independently observed target receipts.

rows.outcome: Repeated native/UI checks, step Proofs and Until Loop repair/test cycles preserve the candidate inside an attempt; startup reset repeats only for a new independent full-case create attempt.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent candidate identity/state observations across repeated checks and repairs; separately declared owned synthetic fixture reset scope and receipts; distinct attempt boundaries.
rows.falsifier: A proof/test/repair rerun destroys the deployed candidate, repeats whole-case teardown, or mutates undeclared fixtures; a new full-case create attempt skips startup cleanup.
rows.unknown_condition: Attempt boundary, candidate preservation or fixture ownership is unverified.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Calibration fixtures do not establish actual live reset; live launch requires independently observed target receipts.

rows.outcome: Source/deployed Apex, schema, API versions and user-owned objects match the frozen candidate.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent full deployable-tree hash and deployment receipt; native Apex body/schema readback and per-user record snapshots.
rows.falsifier: Partial/late deployment, ignored source omission or undeclared object receives credit.
rows.unknown_condition: Current complete deployment, canonical org/user or full source inventory missing.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Post-build: missing setup works without provider success; real app Save persists exact nonsecret configuration, independently read back; app-initiated actual connection succeeds separately before dependent UI/provider acceptance.
rows.independent_evidence: After construction, actual browser empty/setup/error and Save journeys; independent persisted config readback; native app-initiated callout and real provider response join. Before builder start require only authority/reset/containment, operator credential-reference/setup route with grants as appropriate, and actual observation capability/contract, not new-app observations.
rows.falsifier: Mock, old preflight, unsaved form or returned ok flag supplies connection proof; dependent UI/provider acceptance passes without actual app connection evidence; new-app Save/readback/connection is demanded before empty-repo builder starts.
rows.unknown_condition: After construction, auth, key/principal/admin/model setup, Save/readback or app connection unobserved or provider blocked; dependent acceptance remains UNKNOWN and cannot pass.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Named roster, conversations, saved instruction/task versions and user isolation survive reload.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent persisted user-object queries and browser create/select/rename/reload/new-conversation journeys.
rows.falsifier: Browser-only roster or another user can read/edit bot state.
rows.unknown_condition: Persisted state or second identity not observable.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: A real execution receives the snapshotted saved instruction/task version; edits affect subsequent runs.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent saved-version reads and secret-free outbound request projection bound to native worker and provider response.
rows.falsifier: Stored settings exist but active execution ignores them or silently changes version.
rows.unknown_condition: Actual request content/version/native join unavailable.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: At least two distinct Apex worker transactions advance one run before any app tab reopens.
rows.independent_evidence: Timestamped all-tabs-closed and builder/browser-stop evidence; read-only org observations during away interval; exact job IDs, native transactions and committed checkpoints. No app browser, external agent or continuation caller drives work; independent observers perform only declared read-only observations.
rows.falsifier: UI-only spinner, progress on reopen, observer continuation call or one endless transaction is accepted. External agent/continuation-driven work receives browser-away credit.
rows.unknown_condition: Queue delay exceeds frozen deadline, away interval incomplete or distinct native workers cannot be correlated.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Apex owns causal provider/tool/checkpoint continuation.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent native enqueue/job/transaction/callout evidence joined to source/deployment, run/checkpoint, provider response, actual tool result and successor request.
rows.falsifier: Dummy Queueable hides browser/external orchestration or application-authored log supplies sole proof.
rows.unknown_condition: Native correlation unavailable, ambiguous or missing required edges.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Unpredictable allowed-record value read by Apex reaches a subsequent real provider request.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent observer introduces a fresh synthetic nonce after inputs freeze; database snapshot, native read and safe next-request projection show causal transfer. The later actual real-provider request contains the selected structured read result, including the challenge value; app logs alone are insufficient.
rows.falsifier: Nonce is echoed from prompt/UI, tool-shaped prose is accepted, or no executed read exists. Result appears only in an app log or is absent from the later real-provider request.
rows.unknown_condition: No unpredictable fixture, safe request projection or next actual provider request.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Allowlisted context/schema/read/propose tools reject malformed, foreign, arbitrary-query/admin and injected authority requests. Runtime tools exclude cleanup, admin, deployment, authentication and User-account edits; memory/instructions cannot grant those powers.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent native assertions and registry/source review; live readback of protected records and outbound disclosure boundaries. Any isolated rollback-only native test User fixtures are labelled native evidence separately from deployed-app behavior.
rows.falsifier: Unknown tool executes, saved text expands authority or provider-hosted tool performs excluded work.
rows.unknown_condition: Independent registry/denial evidence unavailable.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: No business mutation occurs during setup, connection, proposal creation or before confirmation.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent business baseline and snapshots at each boundary; proposal/history UI and native traces.
rows.falsifier: Silent seeding or proposal DML changes business data before human approval.
rows.unknown_condition: Baseline, observation coverage or authoritative snapshots missing.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: One exact confirmed create and one exact confirmed update match server proposals.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent before/after IDs, counts, exact field values and proposal bindings; native transaction evidence and browser actions.
rows.falsifier: Client fields change intent, wrong target changes or mutation differs from approved values.
rows.unknown_condition: Create or update lacks independent readback or current proposal binding.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Stale, expired, duplicate, tampered and concurrent confirmations cannot cause extra/unauthorized writes; consumption and write are atomic.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent adverse native tests and live duplicate/overlap requests with database snapshots; DML-failure rollback assertions.
rows.falsifier: Two confirmations mutate twice, stale/expired intent executes or failed write leaves a consumed success.
rows.unknown_condition: Any required adverse test or live race/readback absent.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Cancellation serializes with mutation: cancellation winner forbids later writes; committed write winner remains reported.
rows.independent_evidence: Controlled overlapping native/live confirmation-cancel evidence with committed-order observations and independent business/run snapshots.
rows.falsifier: Late mutation after cancellation wins, hidden committed write or provider recall/exactly-once claim.
rows.unknown_condition: Winner cannot be established independently or race not exercised.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Obsolete queued/running workers cannot publish current output, overwrite newer/paused/terminal state or enqueue successors.
rows.independent_evidence: Adverse native worker-generation tests; exact live job lineage and state observations after cancel/pause/recovery.
rows.falsifier: Late worker revives cancelled state or enqueues after invalidation.
rows.unknown_condition: No observed late-worker control or incomplete owned-job lineage.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Queued permission revocation is honored by every worker and recovery path under explicit effective principal.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent permission before/after snapshots, queued job identity, native execution and protected read/write/provider-disclosure assertions.
rows.falsifier: Persisted user ID/cached grants/admin recovery restores revoked authority.
rows.unknown_condition: No restricted principal, queued revocation window or principal correlation.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Cross-user run/history/memory/proposal denial, field-only denial and record-sharing denial each hold.
rows.independent_evidence: Separate independent native cases with controlled permissions and live org readback; inspect all captured outbound request projections for protected nonces.
rows.falsifier: Object denial alone stands in for field-only denial, foreign approval succeeds or protected data reaches provider.
rows.unknown_condition: Distinct denial fixtures/principals/readbacks unavailable.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Interrupted/failed work resumes from committed checkpoints without replaying writes; uncertain provider outcomes remain labelled.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent native faults and recovery assertions; live interrupted/reopened/resumed run and database/job/provider correlations.
rows.falsifier: Resume repeats committed mutation, silently retries uncertain request as exactly once or falsely completes lost work.
rows.unknown_condition: No interruption/recovery observation or ambiguity cannot be reconciled.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Steering receipt and consumption sequences are durable, ordered and visible; follow-up uses retained permitted context.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent event/checkpoint queries, overlapping submissions and browser reload/follow-up; request sequence/version projections.
rows.falsifier: Lost/reordered/duplicate steering, browser-only acknowledgement or stale context accepted.
rows.unknown_condition: No active-run steering, consumption proof or subsequent real request.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Explicit memory survives new conversation with declared bot/user scope; corrections and forgetting affect next checkpoint.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent memory/revision reads and subsequent request projections, new conversation and active-run correction/forget journeys.
rows.falsifier: Transcript storage alone passes, forgotten data is reused as current memory or another bot/user inherits it.
rows.unknown_condition: Missing current revision or request observation; historical transmission cannot be recalled.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Context overflow compacts eligible history with provenance or pauses; operative constraints/results are preserved.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent oversized-context tests plus live app state/request projection under frozen model limit and documented compaction/pause path.
rows.falsifier: Silent truncation removes approvals/steering/tool results or omitted content is claimed consumed.
rows.unknown_condition: Model limit, overflow stimulus or protected-content preservation unobserved.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Desktop and narrow layouts support keyboard/focus, empty/error/running/approval/history/reload states and safe text rendering.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent rendered observations at frozen viewport sizes, keyboard journey and accessible ownership-scoped controls; source/deployment binding.
rows.falsifier: Shell controls satisfy app checks, clipped/hidden text stands in for visible history or script-like record content executes.
rows.unknown_condition: Any required width/state/keyboard observation missing.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Access/setup/queue/provider/malformed-output/DML/limit failures yield truthful safe state and bounded supported recovery.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent native adverse tests including 401/429/5xx/timeouts and callout/DML ordering; live error/recovery UI; actual target API/limit review.
rows.falsifier: Mock provider errors relabelled real, uncommitted-work failure hidden, or stuck work called completed.
rows.unknown_condition: Target API/limits or required failure evidence unavailable.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Independent review accepts code, error checks, useful comments, warranted tombstones and meaningful test adequacy for exact source.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent reviewer identity, source hash/locations, findings/disposition; method-to-assertion-to-executed-result mapping and native coverage.
rows.falsifier: Builder self-report/comment counts substitute for judgment, unwarranted tombstones required or skipped assertions counted passed.
rows.unknown_condition: Independent judgment, source match or executed test mapping missing.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: Fresh installed ShipLoop builder follows actual action packets/callbacks and delivery contract.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent frozen launch/package identities, actual packet/callback trace, accepted criteria and returned product identity.
rows.falsifier: Prompt prose/model label proves launch controls or app success alone proves workflow conformance.
rows.unknown_condition: Missing actual packet/callback/installed identity or returned-source binding.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

rows.outcome: After success, failure or interruption: stop new work, invalidate continuations, account for exact owned jobs/in-flight and late deployments, quiesce, teardown only verified owned resources and independently verify covered absence/restoration.
rows.independent_evidence: Independent ownership ledger and before/after job/deployment/app/data/schema/permission/provider inventories; operator grant/credential disposition and retained evidence. Canonical org/case/run inventory includes older owned prefixes. Separate ownership proof for new temporary provider resources; retain startup, post-attempt and failed receipts with original results/history.
rows.falsifier: Empty job query alone passes, late deployment escapes accounting, unowned job/resource is deleted or kept app permits reuse. Cleanup removes unrelated apps/data/User accounts, other active work, preexisting referenced credentials/keys or run/evidence history; new prefix hides prior owned resources; temporary provider ownership is assumed.
rows.unknown_condition: Unknown ownership, running/late work, missing baseline or incomplete app/provider/diagnostic scope; blocks reuse.
rows.mocked_vs_live: Native mocks are deterministic test evidence only; each listed live/real/browser evidence kind requires actual independent observations.

independent_reviewer_and_judge.session_policy: Separate fresh sessions for independent reviewer and judge.

future_role_controls.identity_policy: Apply actual launch controls at future run; record requested model/effort and controls separately from independently verified served identity. Do not infer served identity from prose or launch request. No global default, installed package or historical identity change.
